name: The Channeler (class portrait)

avoid: a superhero pose · lightning from the eyes
section: Will Power: the Outburst, and the Channeler
prompt:
Create an original Project Heaven Cry illustration in HEAVENPRINT. Use the attached approved Original 27 and New Faces
images as the painting authority: expressive ink and opaque gouache, deliberate angular form, selective dry-brush
scumbling, restrained hatching, charcoal lost edges and warm ivory accents. Faces have believable anatomy and restrained
stylization and specific emotional acting. Format: 4:5, 800 x 1000 PNG, one character from the chest or waist up, one
visible action, one specific emotion, one useful setting hint behind them; the eye line about 22% from the top. The class
attribute's pigment appears only as one accent (given in the section). No text, frame, UI or watermark; no real-world
person, brand or recognisable character. The portrait shows:

Paint: A caster in a long coat with an Emanator glove, a storm-violet heart-burst swelling between their hands, hair lifting, jaw set.
Avoid: a superhero pose · lightning from the eyes
CAST AND STAGING: A 40-year-old pale-olive woman with a strong cleft chin, broad nose, short black hair lifting into asymmetric strands and a tight SET JAW. Waist-up square to viewer, elbows bent, BOTH HANDS clearly separated in front of chest shaping a small SWELLING HEART-BURST, not an anatomical heart. ONE EMANATOR GLOVE on right hand, left bare; hands have coherent wrists/fingers and form a clear empty space around the burst. Long charcoal coat with worn broad collar, no superhero costume, cape, armor, lightning from eyes or emblem pasted in painting. Glove/burst is sole violet light, natural skin and dark cloth retain local color. Quiet stone stairwell and one neutral cool doorway behind. Eye line22%; specific effort in brows, jaw and shoulders.
ACTING SENTENCE: A channeler braces a swelling heart-burst between both hands because it is difficult to hold, and feels fierce controlled effort.
Rendering follows the approved paintings: visible deliberate angular opaque gouache brush blocks, broken ink contours, selective dry scumbling, quiet charcoal lost edges and warm ivory focal planes. Believable face anatomy with restrained illustration stylization, no photo skin/3D gloss/airbrush, no oversized anime eyes. Borrow rendering, NEVER the identity/face/pose/costume of a reference person. The final small motif reference supplies only the class's equipment/gesture motif; DO NOT paste its emblem/frame into painting. Vertical 4:5, full-bleed opaque RGB painting, chest/waist-up, eye line approximately22% from top, face/decisive hands/tool central80%. One person, action, emotion, useful setting hint. Preserve natural skin/cloth/metal colors; one storm-violet #9875D7 heart-burst light accent is the SINGLE ATTRIBUTE ACCENT, never a monochrome wash. No letters, readable glyphs, labels, symbols of real faiths, real insignia, caption, UI, frame, border or watermark.
